prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 83.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 82.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 84.5%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 30.5%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Move sign-in after pet adoption', 'Redesign friend selection to grid with live preview', 'Split layout redesign for adoption certificate', 'Carousel redesign for friend selection screen', 'Two-column layout redesign for path selection', 'Split layout redesign for photo upload screen', 'Stage layout redesign for adoption certificate screen', 'Sign-in retry hint on sign-in screen', 'Sign-in load delay recovery hint']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Waiting step progress timer & delay callout', 'Clear onboarding intro story narrative', 'Ready notification toggle on wait screen', 'Two-column desktop command layout', 'Clear path option copy revision', 'Pet interaction visual tips screen', 'Checklist layout for photo upload screen', 'Desktop launch info on waiting screen', 'Split layout sign-in screen redesign', 'Desktop companion placement guide screen', 'Story scroll layout for story screen', 'Sound notification toggle on waiting screen', 'Grid layout redesign for choose path screen', 'Split layout redesign for pet pick friend screen', 'Account pet sync hint on sign-in screen', 'Desktop tray control hint on finish screen', 'Stage layout redesign for waiting screen', 'Reorder sign-in prior to adoption certificate screen', 'Desktop interaction control copy on intro finish screen', 'Carousel layout for desktop loading waiting screen', 'Stage layout redesign for choose path screen', 'Full bleed adoption certificate preview redesign', 'Desktop pet visibility hint on home intro screen', 'Full bleed layout redesign for waiting screen', 'Compact layout redesign for sign-in screen', 'Spotlight layout redesign for home intro launch screen', 'Cloud pet backup assurance badge on sign-in screen', 'Desktop launch troubleshooting hint on waiting screen', 'Mascot intro centered layout on initial story screen', 'Two-column layout redesign for home intro screen', 'Two-column layout redesign for waiting screen', 'Centered layout redesign for story intro screen', 'Centered layout redesign for home intro screen', 'Spotlight layout redesign for photo upload screen', 'Background desktop preparation hint on waiting screen', 'Card layout redesign for photo upload screen', 'Reorder sign-in after desktop preparation waiting step']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Highlight quick preset vs custom paths', 'Card layout for adoption certificate', 'Redesign final screen into interactive launch stage', 'Interactive mascot path selector', 'Desktop control quickstart screen', 'Move sign-in after pet setup wait', 'Adoption badge reward callout', 'Account sync reassurance panel on sign-in', 'Free toy item unlock incentive', 'Spotlight layout redesign for choose path', 'Sign-in troubleshooting screen before sign-in', 'Account sync hint on sign-in screen', 'Custom pet photo validation preview flow', 'Custom photo guideline hint on photo upload screen', 'Story scroll redesign for friend selection screen', 'Exclusive starter accessory unlock on adoption certificate', 'Guided path preset selector flow', 'Split layout redesign for choose path', 'Pet preview customizer screen insertion']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path layout, finish copy, home layout, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, sign_in redesign).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) and adding hints to the sign-in screen (sign_in, hint) were helpful and delivered winning tests.
Copy revisions on path selection (choose_path, copy) and adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance.
No clear effect was seen for waiting screen changes (home notification, wait_info, redesign, hint) or finish step tweaks (finish hint, finish redesign).
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected measured outcomes.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Grid layout redesign for photo upload screen
candidates.change: Redesign the photo upload screen into a structured multi-card grid layout to better guide custom pet photo submission.
candidates.why: Adoption has a high mean time of 1017s and users reported custom pet creation failures in support tickets.

candidates.title: Pet naming step insertion
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated pet naming screen right after custom photo upload to personalize pet setup before generating the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption step takes median 89s / mean 1017s; adding a focused pet naming step breaks up complex photo setup.

new_pet_naming.headline: Name Your New Pet
new_pet_naming.body: Give your desktop companion a unique name.

candidates.title: Stage layout redesign for pet pick friend screen
candidates.change: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a stage layout presentation highlighting featured pet avatars.
candidates.why: Adoption step takes up to 1017s on average; stage presentation provides high focus for avatar selection.

candidates.title: Split layout redesign for home intro screen
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a split layout presenting desktop placement settings alongside pet activation controls.
candidates.why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and support emails show confusion regarding desktop pet controls.

candidates.title: Carousel layout redesign for choose path screen
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen into a full-width swipeable carousel screen.
candidates.why: 16.9% drop-off on choose path; carousel layout offers clear visual distinction between options.

candidates.title: Existing account pet restoration hint on sign-in
candidates.change: Display a hint explaining that signing in restores existing desktop pets and settings.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (largest theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing into your registered account automatically restores your previously saved pets and progress.

candidates.title: Desktop overlay initialization status hint on waiting screen
candidates.change: Display status updates about desktop overlay initialization and screen rendering during pet setup.
candidates.why: Home waiting step has a long mean time (2336s), and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop.

waiting.hint: Initializing desktop overlay and rendering companion graphics...

candidates.title: Desktop pet launch system notification toggle
candidates.change: Add a system notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when pet initialization completes.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s; users switch away while waiting and lose context.

candidates.title: Cloud storage pet memory backup incentive callout
candidates.change: Add a visual badge explaining that sign-in enables cloud backup for pet personality traits and memories.
candidates.why: Sign-in drop-off is 17.6% and support received multiple complaints about lost pets upon re-login.

components.text: Cloud Sync Enabled: Automatically backs up pet traits and progress

candidates.title: Desktop pet tray icon and control hint on home intro
candidates.change: Add a hint explaining how to locate and control the pet via system tray and desktop shortcuts on the final screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails asking how to control, hide, or interact with the pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Control your pet anytime via the system tray icon or right-clicking directly on your desktop companion.
